prose: Dylan Saccoccio returns to shed more light on the ancient universal mythology of the Holy Sailors. Prepare to explore the artifacts and linguistic evidence linking the Phoenician system of priestcraft to the Norse runes, deities, and stories. Dylan is the author of the Spirit Whirled series, and if you catch up on it, you'll be equipped to see through the lies of mainstream history.
